turns.text: I know this is super short notice, but my best friend's wedding is tomorrow, and I totally forgot about my shift.
turns.zh: 我知道这通知得特别急，但我最好的朋友的婚礼就在明天，我完全忘了排班这回事。

turns.text: Would you be able to cover my shift for me?
I just I really have to be there.
turns.zh: 我只是……我真的必须得去。
